function: above_phy: the only learned part (inverse soft-Q agent) decides the multi-IRS multi-user association (p. 6); trajectory, SIC order and power are solved by SCA.
notes: Reason above_phy. p. 1 abstract: 'We first propose an inverse soft-Q learning-based algorithm to optimize multi-IRS multi-user association. Then, SCA and Dinkelbach-based algorithm are leveraged to optimize UAV trajectory followed by the optimization of SIC decoding order scheduling and power allocation.' p. 6: 'we propose a user association algorithm based on inverse soft-Q learning'; the agent action is the binary association alpha (p. 6). The RIS phase shifts are a closed-form rule (Theorem 1, eq. 10, p. 4). The trajectory is solved by SCA and Dinkelbach, and the SIC order and power by penalty-based SCA, both with CVX (pp. 7 and 9), so no learned component sets a physical-layer variable (power, beams or RIS phases). Paper title matches the DOI (Ning et al., multi-IRS assisted UAV communications).
